posthoc_m5_m3_filter_control.definition: Filter -09-72a envelope_last repaired-event rows after the transition by frozen mechanism in M5_cutoff_change or M3_rows_dropped.
posthoc_m5_m3_filter_control.not_a_candidate_reason: The filter uses the transition's future label to select an already-computed candidate path, so it does not define values for prior or non-event snapshots and cannot itself be scored on the 28,254-snapshot safety population.

envelope_max.definition: For every target-date local minute, retain the highest native-unit value ever observed at or before the current capture.

envelope_last.definition: For every target-date local minute, retain the most recently published value at or before the current capture.

m5_m3_label_gate.kind: nearest point-in-time stateful operationalization of the post-hoc label filter; not eligible for selection
m5_m3_label_gate.definition: Use envelope_last only on frozen -09-71a decrease-event snapshots labelled M5_cutoff_change or M3_rows_dropped; otherwise retain the captured served value and cutoff.
m5_m3_label_gate.reason_ineligible: The label is not a payload observable, the San Francisco M1 label is explicitly audited for raw-row identity error, and this stateful rule does not reproduce the 736 post-hoc retained repairs because the post-hoc filter used the future transition label to select a candidate path that had already changed prior snapshots.

observable_no_published_at_or_after.kind: deterministic point-in-time payload-observable candidate; no fitted parameter
observable_no_published_at_or_after.definition: At capture t, trust every row in the current payload. Recover a previously published missing row only when the current payload contains no row at or after that row's target-date-local minute. If the current payload is empty, every previously published target-date row is eligible for recovery.
observable_no_published_at_or_after.same_timestamp_rule: A current row at the same minute is at-or-after evidence, so the current vendor value replaces every prior value for that minute.

cutoff_rule: Historical captured producer rule: greatest configured cutoff no later than wall clock and no later than the candidate latest observation minute; wall cutoff if no cutoff is eligible.
fallback_rule: When the candidate has no cutoff-eligible WU row, retain that snapshot's captured served high_so_far; no non-WU input is changed.
